targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  predicted_timestamp AS time,
  predicted_value     AS health_score
FROM model_predictions
WHERE station_name = 'shuttle_station'
  AND metric_name  = 'health_score'
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_timestamp)
ORDER BY predicted_timestamp

SELECT
  predicted_timestamp AS time,
  AVG(predicted_value) OVER (
    ORDER BY predicted_timestamp
    RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '${sma_window}' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS health_trend_sma
FROM model_predictions
WHERE station_name = 'shuttle_station'
  AND metric_name  = 'health_score'
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_timestamp)
ORDER BY predicted_timestamp

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    metric_name,
    AVG(value)    AS mu,
    STDDEV(value) AS sigma
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'shuttle_station'
    AND metric_name != 'count'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY metric_name
  HAVING STDDEV(value) > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    t.metric_name,
    MAX(ABS((t.value - s.mu) / s.sigma)) AS max_abs_zscore
  FROM process_metrics t
  JOIN stats s USING (metric_name)
  WHERE t.station_name = 'shuttle_station'
    AND t.metric_name != 'count'
    AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp)
  GROUP BY t.metric_name
  ORDER BY max_abs_zscore DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
zscores AS (
  SELECT
    t.timestamp AS time,
    t.metric_name AS metric,
    (t.value - s.mu) / s.sigma AS zscore
  FROM process_metrics t
  JOIN stats s USING (metric_name)
  JOIN ranked r USING (metric_name)
  WHERE t.station_name = 'shuttle_station'
    AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp)
)
SELECT time, metric, zscore
FROM zscores
ORDER BY time

  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_timestamp)
ORDER BY predicted_timestamp

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    metric_name,
    AVG(value)    AS mu,
    STDDEV(value) AS sigma
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'l2_inspection'
    AND metric_name != 'count'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY metric_name
  HAVING STDDEV(value) > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    t.metric_name,
    MAX(ABS((t.value - s.mu) / s.sigma)) AS max_abs_zscore
  FROM process_metrics t
  JOIN stats s USING (metric_name)
  WHERE t.station_name = 'l2_inspection'
    AND t.metric_name != 'count'
    AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp)
  GROUP BY t.metric_name
  ORDER BY max_abs_zscore DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
zscores AS (
  SELECT
    t.timestamp AS time,
    t.metric_name AS metric,
    (t.value - s.mu) / s.sigma AS zscore
  FROM process_metrics t
  JOIN stats s USING (metric_name)
  JOIN ranked r USING (metric_name)
  WHERE t.station_name = 'l2_inspection'
    AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp)
)
SELECT time, metric, zscore
FROM zscores
ORDER BY time

SELECT gs AS time, 'Warning (+1.5σ)' AS metric, 1.5::float AS zscore
FROM generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz,
  ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) AS gs

SELECT gs AS time, 'Warning (-1.5σ)' AS metric, -1.5::float AS zscore
FROM generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz,
  ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) AS gs

SELECT gs AS time, 'Critical (+3.0σ)' AS metric, 3.0::float AS zscore
FROM generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz,
  ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) AS gs

SELECT gs AS time, 'Critical (-3.0σ)' AS metric, -3.0::float AS zscore
FROM generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz,
  ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) AS gs
